schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.description: Provides 300 units of free electricity per month to households through rooftop solar installations with government subsidies.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: A national mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services like savings accounts, credit, and pensions.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students in Class 9-12 or college, aimed at providing top-class education opportunities.

schemes.name: NaMo Drone Didi Scheme
schemes.description: Empowers women Self Help Groups (SHGs) by providing agricultural drones and training to generate sustainable livelihood.

schemes.name: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)
schemes.description: A comprehensive scheme focused on the welfare, health, and dignity of senior citizens across India.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.description: Recognition and support for artisans and craftspeople through credit support, skill upgrading, and toolkit incentives.

schemes.name: Digital India Bhashini
schemes.description: AI-led translation platform to enable citizens to access digital services in their own mother tongue.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Comprehensive crop insurance for farmers against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
schemes.description: Mission to provide Functional Household Tap Connections to every rural household by ensuring safe drinking water.

schemes.name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate
schemes.description: A one-time small savings scheme for women and girls for a period of 2 years with a fixed interest rate of 7.5%.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN)
schemes.description: Improved mid-day meal scheme focusing on the nutritional status of children in government schools.

schemes.name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
schemes.description: An integrated scheme for school education ensuring inclusive and equitable quality education from pre-school to senior secondary.

schemes.name: Agnipath Recruitment Scheme
schemes.description: A recruitment process for the Armed Forces for youth to serve as Agniveers for a period of 4 years.

schemes.name: e-Shram Portal (UAN Card)
schemes.description: A national database for unorganized workers to facilitate social security benefits and accidental insurance.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (Farmer Solar Energy)
schemes.description: Installation of solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants for farmers to ensure energy security.

schemes.name: MGNREGA Rural Employment
schemes.description: Right to work program guaranteeing 100 days of manual unskilled work for rural households.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
schemes.description: Creation of digital health IDs to store medical records and provide seamless access to healthcare facilities.

schemes.name: PM SHRI Schools
schemes.description: Development of school infrastructure to act as 'exemplar' schools for the National Education Policy 2020.

schemes.name: SVAMITVA Yojana
schemes.description: Mapping of rural inhabited lands using drones to provide 'Record of Rights' through property cards.

schemes.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, and market entry.

schemes.name: PM-DevINE (North East)
schemes.description: Focuses on development projects in the North Eastern Region to fund infrastructure and social development.

schemes.name: PM-USP Scholarship for College Students
schemes.description: Central Sector scholarship for meritorious students from poor families for higher studies.

schemes.name: Khelo India Scheme
schemes.description: Identifies and supports sports talent at a young age to represent India internationally.

schemes.name: Mission Shakti (Sambal & Samarthya)
schemes.description: An integrated mission for women safety, security, and empowerment including One Stop Centres.

schemes.name: PM-DAKSH Yojana
schemes.description: Free skill development training for marginalized groups including SC, ST, and Safai Karamcharis.

schemes.name: AMRUT 2.0
schemes.description: Ensures universal coverage of water supply through functional taps in all urban statutory towns.

schemes.name: Atal Bhujal Yojana
schemes.description: Community-led ground water management scheme to ensure sustainable water resources.

schemes.name: National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)
schemes.description: Strategy to reduce particulate matter concentration in urban air across non-attainment cities.

schemes.name: PM-eBus Sewa
schemes.description: Boosting urban bus transport by deploying electric buses and augmenting city infrastructure.

schemes.name: Skill India Mission
schemes.description: Platform for vocational training and certification to improve youth employability across sectors.

schemes.name: National Career Service (NCS)
schemes.description: Provides job matching, career counseling, and training services to job seekers and employers.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
schemes.description: Collateral-free working capital loan for street vendors to resume their livelihood.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY
schemes.description: Health insurance providing ₹5 lakh cover per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.

schemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentives for pregnant and lactating mothers.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Guaranteed monthly pension for citizens in the unorganized sector starting after age 60.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

schemes.name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families.

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) 2.0
schemes.description: Aims to make cities 'Garbage Free' and ensures gray and black water management.

schemes.name: Digital India Land Records (DILRMP)
schemes.description: Modernizes land record management to reduce title disputes and improve transparency.

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: Old age protection pension for unorganized workers with a monthly income of ₹15,000 or less.
